notes.title: Final release tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11510948/86bece6155b310c16a7fd305d32e92e68b9d6730.jpg[/img]

[b]This is it. After a few weeks of Early Access, we're releasing Crazy Pixel Streaker tomorrow![/b]

A lot have been added to the very last version: more actions with even more crazy weapons, new game modes including insane mini-games. You may even find some nudity now!

Reviews from the Early Access are quite good, thanks a lot for your feedbacks:
[list]
 	[*]"If you usually play funny games with friends, CPS is a must!" - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Gecko4ever/]Geck0[/url][/*]
 	[*]"This is the kind of game that Steam needs more of." - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Mynkon/][VENAOS] ┼ Mynnie ┼[/url][/*]
 	[*]"It is super fun to beat the living hell out of everything [...] it gets even better with a couple of friends (and probably a beer or two :D)." - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/swaffelroyal/]The Uenz[/url][/*]
 	[*]"Oh man this is INSANE!" - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hyoga28/]hyoga28[/url][/*]
[/list]
We hope you will all enjoy the additional features we will be providing you tomorrow. Feel free to tell your friends to join you in this crazy world!

In case you missed it we also just released a new trailer, 100% gameplay based!

notes.title: Crazy Pixel Streaker Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]http://i2.wp.com/lubiterum.com/devblog/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/minigame.jpg?w=1273[/img]

Hey Streaaaakerssss!! Finally, here we go with a new update featuring new minigames plus a tournament system, also the new almanac system and much more! 

Thanks for all your patience and support! We'll announce the final release date very soon! ːsteamhappyː


[b]New content:[/b][list]

[*]3 new minigames for party mode (work in progress)
[*]New minigame's tournament system
[*]New almanac system
[*]New little moles enemies
[*]New cinematic for Pablo
[*]New avatars for all the bosses
[*]New internal language system for future translations
[*]New characters voices added
[*]New functions added to the Alien spaceship screens[/list]


[b]Hockey level:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hockey pucks no longer disappear[/list]


[b]American Football level:[/b]
[list]
[*]Football icon added to the next stage screen
[*]Free fall have been changed
[*]Touchdown added when you score 
[*]The cup event have been changed
[*]More bullet patterns for Pablo have been added
[*]Cup added when killing Pablo
[*]Cheerleader FX added
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Every player can pause the game now
[*]Weapons no longer disappear when using melee
[*]Enemies no longer appear damaged
[*]Analog stick now works on the map 
[*]Jhon sprite have been fixed
[*]Some dialogues have been fixed
[*]Some FX have been fixed
[*]Level progression have been fixed
[*]A LOT of internal bugs have been fixed[/list]

notes.title: Crazy Pixel Streaker Update v1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]http://lubiterum.com/img/zapper.gif[/img]

Streaking a go go! We have new weapons for you ːsteamhappyː The powerful double barrel shotgun and the lethal Zapper! Also a powerful air strike borrowed from Guillermo :P

[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shotgun weapon added
[*]Zapper weapon added
[*]Air strike weapon added
[/list]
[b]American Football level:[/b]
[list][*]Killing Guillermo gives you the new air strike weapon
[*]Pablo's music added
[*]Pablo's mechanics have been changed (work in progress)
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Continues have been removed
[*]Items arrows have been removed
[*]No Damage achievement works fine now
[*]Several internal bugs have been fixed[/list]

[b]Menu/Options:[/b][list]

[*]Mouse works with the volume sliders now[/list]

We wanted to add the new mini games in this update, that was our original plan, but it was more complicated than we first thought and we don't wanted to delay the weapons update. We keep working on them, thank you for your support! As a preview please check the new minigames menu. Coming soon! ;)

[img]http://lubiterum.com/img/minigames_menu.gif[/img]

notes.title: Week 4 Crazy Pixel Streaker Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]http://i1.wp.com/lubiterum.com/devblog/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/combo_diamonds.gif?resize=636%2C477[/img]

[img]http://i1.wp.com/lubiterum.com/devblog/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/20160328141122_1.jpg?w=800[/img]

Happy (late) Easter streakers! We’ve a new update ready for you with new content and tons of bugs fixes! ːsteamhappyː

[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*]New bag of coins added plus diamonds when making a combo
[*]New followers deathly magic attack x9 added
[*]New “burn ‘em all” event added[/list]
[b]Soccer level:[/b]
[list][*]Falling bombs stops after killing Guillermo[/list]
[b]Hockey level:[/b]
[list]
[*]If you start playing on the Hockey stadium you can continue from there
[*]Throwing enemies into the water works fine now
[*]Fixed some weird bug when you try to kill Toby
[*]Fixed some depth problems when fighting Toby
[*]Changed Toby’s avatar
[*]Little walrus pick up sound+feedback added
[*]Blizzard sound is moure louder now
[*]Fixed penguin mount music duration[/list]
[b]American Football level:[/b][list]
[*]The difficulty have been changed
[*]The cup event works fine now[/list]
[b]Online:[/b][list]
[*]Added new symbols for the chat function
[*]When a player dies you can pick up his followers now
[*]Mouse revive works fine now
[*]Reviving a character is easier
[*]Fixed some lag problems in the alien spaceship
[*]Fixed a bug when killing Guillermo
[*]Fixed some synchronization problems with Guillermo
[*]Fixed some synchronization problems with Toby
[*]Fixed some synchronization problems with the machetes
[*]Fixed some synchronization problems with the events
[*]Fixed some synchronization problema with the cook hat
[*]Fixed several crashes when entering the alien spaceship
[*]Fixed some problems with the cabaret bombs
[*]Fixed some weird problems when a player dies
[*]Pause menu works fine now
[*]Several internal bugs have been fixed[/list]
[b]Arena/Party mode:[/b][list]
[*]Retrying option is no longer missing
[*]Fixed some problem when unlocking the achievements[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b][list]
[*]New sound for the machine-tomato-gun added
[*]Item arrows added
[*]Chest sound added
[*]Barbieking’s magic attack no longer "gets lost"
[*]Mounts hitbox are bigger
[*]Fixed some shadows problems
[*]Fixed some collision problems
[*]Fixed some alignment problems with the hats
[*]Fixed some weird behaviour with the cook hat[/list]
[b]Menu/Options:[/b][list]
[*]Mouse  is deactivated when using pad and viceversa[/list]

 Thanks again for all your support! :)

notes.title: Week 2 Crazy Pixel Streaker Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://www.thesidek.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/10472358.png[/img]
Yesterday we made a tiny mistake between two versions of the game (GDC build and normal build). So not all the fixes and content we talked about wasn’t in the yesterday version of the game. This new patch is there to repair that, sorry guys! And also as a compensation we have fixed new bugs and added new features! So finally, it’s good news! :D

You can check the new patch:

[b]Hockey level:[/b][list]

[*]    Now it's possible to pick up Toby's cup
[*]    Followers no longer get stuck in water
[/list]
[b]Arena/Party mode:[/b]
[list]
   [*] Sports players no longer appear in Arena mode
[*]    Added a new event every 3 waves
[*]    Arena achievements added
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
   [*] Animal mounts are bigger and faster
[*]    Added visual feedback when taking damage
[*]    Hockey and American football stadiums are unlocked (if you unlock 50% of the challenges)
[*]    Pause menu now works in the alien spacechip
[*]    Fixed some problems with the Steamcloud save
[*]    Alt+f4 now works fine
[*]    Hats achievements added
[*]    Attract mode is skippable using keyboard and the music stops
[*]    Chests have collision now
[*]    Dialogues are no longer in auto mode
[*]    Swat enemies are no longer invencible when dodging
[*]    The map have been reduced to see the other islands[/list]

notes.title: Week 2 Crazy Pixel Streaker Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]http://www.thesidek.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3957787.png[/img]

Hey streakers! We’ve been working on fixing more bugs in our second update for Crazy Pixel Streaker. Thanks again for your feedback! Expect new content for the next update ːpleasedː

Here’s the patch notes:

[b]Soccer level:[/b]
[list]
  [*]  Guillermo’s bullets have been changed
[/list]
[b]Hockey level:[/b]
[list]

[*]    The number of hockey players have been reduced
 [*]   The hockey stadium is no longer empty when you retry
[*]    Added little walrus exploding sound
 [*]   Toby’s ray of death is more easy to dodge
[*]    No damage achievement fixed
 [*]   Toby’s splash screen no longer appears cut
[/list]
[b]American football level[/b]:
[list]
[*]    American football players no longer appear after the first wave
  [*]  Added American football stadium music
[/list]
[b]Online:[/b]
[list]
 [*]   The congratulations song stops if you quit the match
 [*]   Objects no longer disappear after retrying the level
[*]    A weird leprechaun bug have been fixed
[/list]
[b]Arena/Party mode:[/b]
[list]
 [*]   Now it’s more easy to score (karts)
  [*]  Karts behaviour have been fixed
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some weird text removed when you kill a boss
   [*] The bosses dialogues have been fixed
[*]    The retry coins are no longer decimal
[*]    Items no longer fly away
   [*] Now the score is reset after retrying the level
[*]    Don’t take damage event now works fine
   [*] Cursor size now is resizable according to the camera’s zoom
[*]    Now you can play the game with keyboard only
[/list]
Please keep sending us your valuable feedback! Have an awesome week!

[b]Next update...[/b]

[list]
[*]New magic x9 followers
[*]New more valuable coins system
[*]New redesigned continue system
[*]And much more![/list]
